test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the number of workers of different categories A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H in a factory in 1995.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b8707c043d788900578d908aba25d835eefe59d22fdd6dfed846dd34c03555.png] 

What is the central angle (angular value) for category B of the pie chart?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b8707c043d788900578d908aba25d835eefe59d22fdd6dfed846dd34c03555.png] 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

100% = 360°

1% = 3.6°

The value of B = 15%

Then,

⇒ 15%

⇒ 1% × 15

⇒ 3.6 × 15

⇒ 54°

**⇒ ****Hence, The Required value is 54°.**
